examples.name: science abstract: bumblebee navigation
examples.text: Bumblebees are known to use visual landmarks when returning to their nest, but the role of polarized skylight under overcast conditions remains unclear. Here we tracked 214 foraging workers of Bombus terrestris using harmonic radar while selectively blocking the ultraviolet polarization pattern with filter canopies. Bees under blocked canopies took on average 41 percent longer to return and showed increased looping flights near the release point, suggesting that polarization cues remain informative even when the sun is hidden.

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('sales.csv', parse_dates=['date'])
# total revenue per region per month
monthly = (
    df.assign(month=df['date'].dt.to_period('M'))

      .sum()
)

examples.name: code: SQL with explanation
examples.text:
To find customers who placed an order in every month of 2025, count the distinct months per customer and keep only those with all twelve:

SELECT customer_id
FROM orders
WHERE order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND order_date < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY customer_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_date)) = 12;

Note that the date range uses a half-open interval so that orders placed late on December 31 are still included.

examples.name: health: iron deficiency
examples.text: Iron deficiency develops gradually, so early symptoms are easy to miss. Many people first notice unusual tiredness, shortness of breath when climbing stairs, or feeling cold more often than others. As the deficiency progresses, the skin may look paler, nails can become brittle or spoon-shaped, and some people develop cravings for ice. A blood test measuring ferritin is the most reliable way to confirm low iron stores before anemia appears.
